expressions.cue: Eleven people attend a meeting. Write the complete quantity with 人 (名 is also accepted).
expressions.explanation: Build the entire number before its counter. Compounds ending in one use いちにん, not ひとり; four people uses よにん. 名 is the formal person-count alternative; it is not a reading of 人.
